parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Show that the temperature $T$ of the gas is approximately $300\text{ K}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The temperature of the gas is increased to $350\text{ K}$ at constant volume. The specific heat capacity of the gas for this change is $0.66\text{ J kg}^{-1}\text{ K}^{-1}$.

Calculate the energy supplied to the gas by heating.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain how movement of the gas molecules causes pressure in the container.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
The temperature of a gas depends on the root-mean-square (r.m.s.) speed of its molecules.

Calculate the ratio:
$$\frac{\text{r.m.s. speed of gas molecules at }350\text{ K}}{\text{r.m.s. speed of gas molecules at }300\text{ K}}.$$

stem:
A large container of volume $85\text{ m}^3$ is filled with $110\text{ kg}$ of an ideal gas. The pressure of the gas is $1.0 \times 10^5\text{ Pa}$ at temperature $T$.

The mass of $1.0\text{ mol}$ of the gas is $32\text{ g}$.
